examples.title: Apply the animated goal from Foundry's flocking sample
examples.code:
# Reproduce the animated goal control from Foundry's sample.
flock = nuke.createNode("ParticleFlock")
flock["goal"].fromScript("{curve x1 0 x50 100} 0 0")

provenance.editorial_note: This intentionally uses fromScript because the official sample stores animation in Nuke script syntax.

status_reason: Source-backed editorial example(s) added from Foundry research pass 1.
